svg.aria-label: Original energy-level and spectral schematics. S₀ and S₁ denote the ground and first excited singlet states; horizontal levels represent vibrations. Energy lost before fluorescence shifts emission toward longer wavelength. The right-hand bands are constructed examples, not measured 1EMA spectra.
